Transport Documents

सीमा शुल्क घोषणा

An official statement submitted to customs authorities detailing imported or exported goods, values, origin, and duties, as required by WCO and national laws.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official statement submitted to customs authorities detailing imported or exported goods, values, origin, and duties, as required by WCO and national laws.

Operational example

A customs declaration must be completed electronically before goods arrive at the EU’s external border for clearance processing.
